search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: List power circuits, data protocols and any RF channels within the proposed hybrid assembly.
copy.zh: 列明复合组件中的动力回路、数据协议及射频通道。

copy.en: Define insert layout, contact sizes, keying and separation of power and signal contacts.
copy.zh: 定义插芯布局、触点规格、防呆及动力与信号触点隔离。

copy.en: Review current heating together with pair construction, shielding and the data-link requirements.
copy.zh: 结合载流温升、线对结构、屏蔽及数据链路要求审核设计。

copy.en: Agree chassis bonding, return conductors and screen termination at both ends.
copy.zh: 约定机壳搭接、回流导体及两端屏蔽端接。

copy.en: Confirm the shared jacket, branch geometry, bend clearance and connector exit in the enclosure.
copy.zh: 确认共用护套、分支几何形状、弯曲净空及机壳内出线。

copy.en: Validate power loading and data operation together in the actual system configuration.
copy.zh: 在实际系统配置中同时验证供电负载与数据工作。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
